design.notes: Rebuilt index.html to match the Phase 1D approved spec: dark navy theme (#0F131C/#171D29/#6C63FF etc.), sticky top nav (Summary/Daily/Weekly/Channels/Funnel/Adnoc/Actions), Chart.js bar charts for Yesterday-vs-PrevDay, Week-vs-Week, Overall Funnel, and Adnoc Funnel, collapsed 'View calculation details' sections for weekly and funnel breakdowns, and abbreviated KPI numbers (e.g. 8.8K, AED 142K). This is now the locked approved design — recurring runs must only update data/values, not redesign. Do not revert to the old light theme.

slack_recipients.name: GA4 Reporting - Motor UAE
slack_recipients.rule: STAKEHOLDER-facing. Format: KPI comparisons only (this vs that, with the % or pp change) — no explanations, no narrative, no framing of anything as a problem, risk, or concern, whether it's a business metric (e.g. revenue, PPC, purchases dipping) or a data-quality/methodology matter. Do not include 'Main issue', 'Action', causes, or recommendations. If a line would read as flagging an issue in any subtle way, it does not belong here — move it to #digital-marketing-team-firsttech instead. Only include: the metric name, the two values being compared, the change, and the report link.
slack_recipients.example_format:
✅ Shory Motor GA4 report updated

Data: [Yesterday] vs [Previous Day]
This week: [dates] vs [dates]
Total Users: [value] ([+/-X%])
Purchases: [value] ([+/-X%])
Revenue: [value] ([+/-X%])
Report: [link]

slack_recipients.name: #digital-marketing-team-firsttech
slack_recipients.rule: INTERNAL working channel. Anything that is or reads as an issue goes here instead of the stakeholder group DM — this includes business performance concerns (metric declines, softness, underperformance vs benchmarks), not just data-quality/methodology issues. Send data-quality issues, corrections, methodology notes, business performance concerns, and anything flagged as a problem or caveat here. Can also receive the same comparisons sent to the stakeholder group if relevant.

Revenue figures were confirmed correct throughout — only the purchase count was wrong. All daily files 2026-07-06 through 2026-07-16 were corrected using the true lowercase 'purchase' event count. Adnoc-segment purchase counts are still under review for the same issue. Per the notifications rule above, this kind of note goes to #digital-marketing-team-firsttech, never to the stakeholder group DM.
